info.title: Paybito Monetize Service API
info.description: REST API documentation for Paybito Bitohub Monetize Service.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: APIs for retrieving shop owner dashboard information, including shop status, today's KPIs, and pending orders.

tags.name: Creators
tags.description: APIs for creating, updating, retrieving, verifying, deleting, and checking monetization eligibility of creators.

tags.name: Shop Settings
tags.description: APIs for managing shop settings, restricted products, shop review requests, shop verification, and shop details.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: APIs for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and managing products, product visibility, activation status, variants, and inventory.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: APIs for creating, retrieving, fulfilling, cancelling, returning, and refunding orders.

tags.name: Collections
tags.description: APIs for creating, updating, deleting, retrieving, and managing product collections.

tags.name: Payouts
tags.description: APIs for retrieving payout revenue breakdowns, payout statements, lifetime earnings, and platform fee information.

tags.name: Shipping
tags.description: APIs for managing shipping templates and shipping configuration.

tags.name: Media Content Tagging
tags.description: APIs for tagging products to media content, retrieving media with tagged products, and updating media product analytics.

tags.name: Collaborations
tags.description: APIs for creating, updating, retrieving, accepting, rejecting, submitting, completing, and deleting creator-brand collaborations.

tags.name: Fan Subscription
tags.description: APIs for creating and managing fan subscription tiers and subscription plans.

tags.name: Ad Revenue
tags.description: APIs for retrieving creator advertising revenue, earnings summaries, performance metrics, format-wise earnings, recent transactions, and revenue chart data.

tags.name: User Address
tags.description: APIs for managing user addresses, including fetching, adding, updating, and deleting saved addresses.

tags.name: Cart
tags.description: APIs for managing buyer shopping carts, cart items, quantities, and cart operations.

tags.name: Product Reviews
tags.description: APIs for creating product reviews, retrieving product rating summaries, and fetching product reviews.

tags.name: Shop Reports
tags.description: APIs for reporting shops, retrieving pending shop reports, and reviewing reported shops.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: APIs for retrieving creator analytics, revenue performance, audience demographics, engagement data, top-performing content, and business funnel metrics.

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: APIs for creating and managing transaction records.

tags.name: Merchandise Analytics
tags.description: APIs for retrieving merchandise analytics, including KPIs, sales funnel, time-series metrics, top products, and traffic sources.

tags.name: Gifts & Badges
tags.description: APIs for retrieving gifts and badges dashboard information and revenue summary.

tags.name: Tax
tags.description: APIs for managing W-9 tax profiles, W-9 details, and 1099-K transaction reports.

tags.name: Brand
tags.description: APIs for managing brand campaigns, creators, campaign offers, messages, and escrow operations.

tags.name: Creator Collaboration
tags.description: APIs for creators to retrieve collaboration campaign offers with filtering, search, date range, and pagination support.

post.description:
Adds one or more products to the specified collection.

The request body contains a list of product IDs.

The request body contains a list of product IDs to be removed.

200.description: Products removed from the collection successfully.

post.description:
Creates a new product collection for a shop owner.

The collection information must be provided as a JSON string in the
request parameter named 'request'. Optional media files can be supplied
using the 'files' parameter.

Uploaded files are sent to the BitoHub file-upload service and the
resulting media URLs are attached to the collection before it is saved.

The collection must contain a valid shopOwnerId and collection name.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Collection information provided as a JSON string.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: Optional image/media files for the collection.

200.description: Collection created successfully or a business validation/upload error was returned.

value.message: Shop owner ID and Collection Name are required

post.description:
Retrieves active and completed collaboration campaigns that have
chat messages associated with the specified creator.

The request body contains the creator ID and pagination information.
Campaigns are ordered by creation date in descending order.

The response contains the total number of campaigns returned,
campaign details, and operation status information.

Campaigns With Chat.summary: Campaigns with chat messages retrieved successfully

post.description:
Sends a campaign offer to a creator based on the provided
BrandCampaignOffer details.

The request contains campaign, creator, budget, KPI, offer status,
and deliverable information. The response contains the resulting
campaign and offer information along with brand, creator, message,
and escrow details.

Retrieves collaboration campaign offers available to a creator.

Supports filtering by campaign status, start date, end date, search term,
pagination, and creator ID.

The search term is provided in the request body as plain text.
If pagination values are not provided, the service defaults to page 1
with a page size of 10.

200.description: Collaboration offers retrieved successfully or a business/validation response was returned.

post.description:
Uploads or updates a deliverable associated with a specific
collaboration deal.

The deal ID is passed as a path parameter and the deliverable
information is provided as a JSON string in the request body.

The API returns HTTP 200 for both successful and failed upload
operations. The success field indicates the actual operation result.

Retrieves all brand campaign offers associated with the specified creator.

The creator ID is passed as a path parameter. Each offer contains
campaign information, budget, KPI details, creator and brand information,
offer status, and associated campaign deliverables.

success set to false and an empty data list.

Retrieves a creator using the creator's registered email address.

200.description: Revenue by source CSV generated successfully

get.description: Fetches the revenue forecast summary for a specific creator. The response contains forecast information including period, historical revenue, forecasted revenue, confidence level, and display label. If forecast data is not available, the API returns a successful response with an empty forecast list.

200.description: Forecast summary fetched successfully or no forecast data is available

500.description: Internal server error while fetching forecast summary

get.description: Retrieves the complete analytics dashboard for a creator based on the selected time range. The dashboard includes revenue summary, revenue sources, daily revenue breakdown, engagement heatmap, audience demographics, top-performing content, and business funnel metrics.

parameters.name: creatorId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the creator whose analytics are being requested.

parameters.name: rangeDays
parameters.description: Time range for which analytics data should be retrieved.

400.description: Invalid creator ID or analytics range

404.description: No analytics data found for the creator

get.description: Retrieves revenue forecast data for a creator for the specified forecast period. The response includes historical revenue, forecasted revenue, confidence level, and display label for each forecast item.

400.description: Invalid creator ID or forecast period

get.description: Retrieves advertising revenue chart data for a specific creator based on the selected time period. Supported filters are 24H (last 24 hours), 7D (last 7 days), 30D (last 30 days), and 90D (last 90 days). If no time filter is provided, the API defaults to 7D.

500.description: Failed to retrieve revenue chart data

get.description: Retrieves the creator's revenue breakdown for the specified period. The response contains revenue generated from advertisements, collaborations, gifts, merchandise, and subscriptions. The default period is WEEK.

400.description: Invalid user identifier or revenue period

value.message: Invalid user identifier or revenue period

get.description: Retrieves the most recent advertising revenue and wallet payout transactions for a specific creator. The number of transactions returned can be controlled using the limit parameter. The default limit is 10.

400.description: Invalid user identifier or transaction limit

value.message: Invalid user identifier or transaction limit

get.description: Retrieves advertising performance metrics for a creator, including current CPM, total ad impressions, view-through rate (VTR), and ad fill rate.

Retrieves the advertising revenue breakdown for a creator based on content format. The response provides revenue, total impressions, and CPM for formats such as Reels, Feed Posts, Stories, and Live Streams.

Retrieves the advertising revenue earnings summary for a specific creator. The response contains today's earnings, weekly earnings, monthly earnings, lifetime earnings, available balance, and growth percentages for today, this week, and this month.

Retrieves the complete advertising revenue dashboard for a creator. The dashboard includes earnings summary, earnings by content format, performance metrics, recent transactions, and revenue chart data for the last 7 days.

bearerAuth.description: PayBito sign-in token of the user (BitoCircle app and white-label communities). Send together with the uuid header.
bearerAuth.name: Authorization

uuidHeader.description: The signed-in user's uuid. Required with the bearer token.
uuidHeader.name: uuid

apiKeyAuth.description: API key created in BitoCircle Settings > API Keys: base64(apiKey:secret), the same as the PayBito exchange API. Alternatively send the raw API key here and the secret in X-MBX-SECRETKEY. Calls must come from a whitelisted IP (and Origin, if domains are whitelisted).
apiKeyAuth.name: X-MBX-APIKEY

appOAuth.description: Developer-portal apps on the BitoCircle Platform. Send Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> and X-CLIENT-ID: <clientId>. Each endpoint lists the scope it needs.

scopes.bitocircle.profile.read: View your profile: Your profile, followers and public profiles you can see.
scopes.bitocircle.profile.write: Manage your profile: Follow and unfollow, update profile and cover pictures, pages.
scopes.bitocircle.feed.read: View your feed: Your home feed, search, suggestions and trending topics.
scopes.bitocircle.post.read: View posts: Posts, reels, tags and shares you can see.
scopes.bitocircle.post.write: Post for you: Create, edit and delete your posts and reels, like, bookmark and share.
scopes.bitocircle.comment.read: View comments: Comments on posts you can see.
scopes.bitocircle.comment.write: Comment for you: Add, edit, like and delete your comments.
scopes.bitocircle.story.read: View stories: Stories you can see.
scopes.bitocircle.story.write: Post stories: Create and delete your stories, view and react to stories.
scopes.bitocircle.message.read: Read your messages: Your conversations and direct messages.
scopes.bitocircle.message.write: Send messages for you: Send, edit and delete your messages, manage your groups.
scopes.bitocircle.channel.read: View channels: Channels you own or follow, and their messages.
scopes.bitocircle.channel.write: Manage channels: Post in and manage your channels, subscribe and unsubscribe.
scopes.bitocircle.notification.read: View notifications: Your notifications and unread counts.
scopes.bitocircle.notification.write: Manage notifications: Mark notifications read, mute and register devices.
scopes.bitocircle.live.read: View live streams: Active live streams and their details.
scopes.bitocircle.live.write: Go live for you: Start and end your live streams, react in streams.
scopes.bitocircle.poll.read: View polls: Polls and their results.
scopes.bitocircle.poll.write: Vote in polls: Vote in polls and manage your polls.
scopes.bitocircle.activity.read: View your activity: Your activity history and bookmarks.
scopes.bitocircle.settings.read: View your settings: Your privacy and notification settings (read only).
scopes.bitocircle.shop.read: View your shop: Your shop, products, orders, addresses and reviews.
scopes.bitocircle.shop.write: Manage your shop: Products, collections, shipping and shop settings. Never payments.
scopes.bitocircle.creator.read: View creator earnings: Your subscriptions, gifts, badges, ad revenue and analytics.
scopes.bitocircle.brand.read: View brand campaigns: Your brand campaigns, offers and collaborations.
scopes.bitocircle.brand.write: Manage brand campaigns: Create campaigns, send offers and messages. Never releases payments.
